description: Mathematical binding between MT-LAW-A persistence and LAW014 selection pressure, disambiguating the role of pressure in structural stability.

binding_logic.pressure_vs_resilience: LAW014 Selection Pressure (S_C_i) is mapped to MT-LAW-A Stabilization-Pressure (P_stab). It is an external or internal forcing that maintains the channel. MT-LAW-A Cost-to-Destabilize (S_C) is the structural resilience of that channel against adversarial perturbation. They are distinct quantities.
binding_logic.causal_coupling: High P_stab (LAW014) maintains S_achieved (Persistence), but may negatively impact S_C (Resilience) if the pressure exhausts the finite admissibility budget (LAW021).

formal_mappings.operational_note: The selection pressure defined in LAW014 provides the continuous forcing required to sustain a persistence channel.
The boundary margin in LAW014 contributes to the overall cost-to-destabilize, but S_C also includes budget and residue factors not fully defined in LAW014.

interaction_rules.description: Persistence (S_achieved) is sustained only while P_stab > 0 and the cost of maintaining P_stab < B_A (local budget).
Increasing P_stab (Selection Pressure) beyond the optimal threshold may induce channel fracture (LAW013) by depleting local resilience.
